程序包 org.bukkit.event.inventory

类 InventoryClickEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryEvent
org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryInteractEvent
org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryClickEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
直接已知子类:
CraftItemEvent, InventoryCreativeEvent
public class InventoryClickEvent extends InventoryInteractEvent
This event is called when a player clicks a slot in an inventory. 当玩家点击物品栏中的某个槽位时调用此事件。

Because InventoryClickEvent occurs within a modification of the Inventory, not all Inventory related methods are safe to use. 由于 InventoryClickEvent 是在物品栏的修改过程中发生的，并非所有与物品栏相关的方法都可以安全使用。

The following should never be invoked by an EventHandler for InventoryClickEvent using the HumanEntity or InventoryView associated with this event: 对于 InventoryClickEvent，事件处理器绝不应使用与该事件关联的 HumanEntity 或 InventoryView 调用以下方法：

  • HumanEntity.closeInventory()
  • HumanEntity.openInventory(Inventory)
  • HumanEntity.openWorkbench(Location, boolean)
  • HumanEntity.openEnchanting(Location, boolean)
  • InventoryView.close()
To invoke one of these methods, schedule a task using BukkitScheduler.runTask(Plugin, Runnable), which will run the task on the next tick. Also be aware that this is not an exhaustive list, and other methods could potentially create issues as well. 如需调用其中某个方法，请使用 BukkitScheduler.runTask(Plugin, Runnable) 安排一个任务，它将在下一个 tick 执行。另请注意，这并非完整的列表，其他方法也可能引发问题。

Assuming the EntityHuman associated with this event is an instance of a Player, manipulating the MaxStackSize or contents of an Inventory will require an Invocation of Player.updateInventory(). 假设与该事件关联的 EntityHuman 是一个 Player 实例，修改物品栏的 MaxStackSize 或内容将需要调用 Player.updateInventory()。

Modifications to slots that are modified by the results of this InventoryClickEvent can be overwritten. To change these slots, this event should be cancelled and all desired changes to the inventory applied. Alternatively, scheduling a task using BukkitScheduler.runTask(Plugin, Runnable), which would execute the task on the next tick, would work as well. 对那些会被此 InventoryClickEvent 的结果所修改的槽位所做的改动可能被覆盖。若要更改这些槽位，应取消该事件并手动应用所有期望的物品栏更改；或者，使用 BukkitScheduler.runTask(Plugin, Runnable) 安排一个在下一个 tick 执行的任务也可以。

    • setCursor

      @Deprecated public void setCursor(ItemStack stack)
      已过时。
      This changes the ItemStack in their hand before any calculations are applied to the Inventory, which has a tendency to create inconsistencies between the Player and the server, and to make unexpected changes in the behavior of the clicked Inventory. 这会在对物品栏应用任何计算之前更改玩家手中的 ItemStack，往往会在玩家与服务器之间造成不一致，并对被点击物品栏的行为产生意料之外的更改。
      Sets the item on the cursor. 设置光标上的物品。
      参数:
      stack - the new cursor item 新的光标物品

    • getAction

      public InventoryAction getAction()
      Gets the InventoryAction that triggered this event. 获取触发该事件的 InventoryAction。

      This action cannot be changed, and represents what the normal outcome of the event will be. To change the behavior of this InventoryClickEvent, changes must be manually applied. 该操作无法更改，它代表了事件的正常结果。若要更改此 InventoryClickEvent 的行为，必须手动应用更改。

      返回:
      the InventoryAction that triggered this event. 触发该事件的 InventoryAction。
